reference_note: No published NVFP4 checkpoint in a comparable format. FLUX.1-schnell-onnx contains an NVFP4 transformer, but it is ONNX for TensorRT and cannot be compared tensor-for-tensor against a Diffusers export.
licence_note: Apache-2.0, so this arm is the one to use for anything shown publicly or handed to a third party. FLUX.1-dev is non-commercial.
filter_map_note: Deliberate mismatch: schnell weights quantized under flux-dev's exclusion filter. The stock schnell run leaves the model-level proj_out quantized because schnell has no filter-map entry and falls back to a generic default. Comparing the two isolates what that one layer costs.

generation.steps_note: 4 steps and guidance 0.0 are the schnell defaults, matching the sibling flux-1-benchmarking sample. Three seeds so the sample size matches the flux-dev arm and the two can be compared.

quantization.calib_steps_note: Matched to the model's inference step count, not copied from flux-dev. Calibration records activation ranges by running the denoising loop, so calibrating over 20 steps for a model that infers in 4 would collect statistics from timesteps schnell never visits. Model Optimizer's own guidance makes the same distinction: 20-30 steps for SD/SDXL, but 4 for SDXL-Turbo, which is the equivalent distilled model.

scope.transformer: NVFP4 weights and activations, except the layers Model Optimizer protects
scope.attention: FP8 when --quantize-mha is set and head dimension divides by 16
